steps.code:
# Fetch all liked songs (paginate)
liked_song_ids = set()
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    for song in page:
        liked_song_ids.add(song['song_id'])
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1
print("Total liked songs:", len(liked_song_ids))
print("Liked song IDs:", sorted(liked_song_ids))

steps.code:
# Go to previous song until we reach a liked song
current_song = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
print("Current song before previous:", current_song)

# Loop until current song is liked
while current_song['song_id'] not in liked_song_ids:
    # Go to previous song
    result = apis.spotify.previous_song(access_token=access_token)
    print("Previous song result:", result)
    # Get the new current song
    current_song = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
    print("New current song:", current_song)

print("Reached liked song:", current_song)
